member.name: T:Fuxion.AspNetCore.ResponseExtensions
member.summary: Provides extension methods to convert and objects into ASP.NET Core action results ( and ).
member.remarks:
This class handles the conversion of Response objects to appropriate HTTP responses, including:
Success responses with various payload types (objects, streams, bytes, strings)
Error responses mapped to standard HTTP status codes
File download support for Stream and byte array payloads
ProblemDetails format for errors following RFC 7807

member.value: to include exception information in responses; otherwise, . Default is .
member.remarks: When enabled, exception information is serialized and added to the response extensions. This should typically be disabled in production environments to avoid leaking sensitive information.
